causal_chain: distinct operation IDs share logical_action_name v11_tool_0
v11_online.frameworks registered and called both FunctionTool objects as v11_tool_0
framework name collision selected one registered callable for both calls
both provider calls returned outcomes attributed through the selected callable closure
outcomes_by_operation lacked one expected operation ID
